summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a Form 6-K (Report of Foreign Private Issuer) furnishing an earnings press release for its fiscal Q2 2026 ended March 31, 2026. The release highlights financial and operational metrics: staking/validation revenue (9,171 SOL, down 6% QoQ), Assets under Delegation (3.8M SOL, up 15%), and total SOL holdings (~524,000). The filing is a routine periodic earnings communication with no special-situation event (e.g., no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return). The company will host a webcast to discuss results. This is a standard earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
